page.overview:
What is Rusukaina?

Rusukaina is an island in the Calm Belt that is to the northwest of Amazon Lily. Once home to the now fallen , it is a harsh island that has forty eight seasons a year which change almost weekly. It was here that Monkey D. Luffy spent two years honing his skills and mastering Haki under the tutelage of Silvers Rayleigh after the Summit War of Marineford.

There are several different species of dangerous animals on Rusukaina. Boa Hancock openly stated that the island is dangerous even by Kuja standards. The only safe area on the island is a tree which animals avoid. This tree is similar to Daft Green but does not emit poison.

According to Silvers Rayleigh, when Monkey D. Luffy arrived on the island, there were over five hundred beasts living there he would not be able to defeat unless he got stronger.

After the timeskip, Monkey D. Luffy successfully mastered Haki and completely conquered the island.
